nodes.name: Express Server Bootstrap
nodes.description: Creates the Express application, wires the HTTP server and Socket.io, and orchestrates startup ordering from config validation through data seeding to listening on the configured port.

nodes.name: Global Middleware Stack
nodes.description: Cross-cutting Express middleware: compression, CORS, Helmet headers, feature policy, robots/security.txt, body and multipart parsing, rate limiting and IP filtering.

nodes.name: Auto-generated Finale REST Resources
nodes.description: Generates CRUD endpoints for every Sequelize model via finale-rest, including attribute exclusion, on-the-fly i18n of products/challenges/hints and the wallet-on-registration hook.

nodes.name: Custom REST Route Registration
nodes.description: The central route map: binds every hand-written /rest, /api, /b2b and file endpoint to its handler together with the auth middleware that guards it.

nodes.name: Error Handling & Stack Trace Exposure
nodes.description: Terminal error middleware combining the challenge error-handling verifier with the verbose errorhandler package that leaks stack traces.

nodes.name: Angular Client Delivery
nodes.description: Catch-all handler serving the built Angular SPA index for unmatched routes, after static asset middleware has had its chance.

nodes.name: Redirect Endpoint
nodes.description: The /redirect endpoint that forwards users to a target URL based on an allow-list check on the query string.

nodes.name: Application Metadata & i18n API
nodes.description: Exposes the running version, the sanitised runtime configuration, the available translation bundles and the country mapping consumed by the frontend at bootstrap.

nodes.name: WebSocket Events & Notifications
nodes.description: Socket.io listeners relaying challenge notifications and hacking-instructor progress, together with the repeat-notification endpoint and client toasts.

nodes.name: JWT Authentication & Session
nodes.description: Issues, signs and verifies the JWT bearer tokens used for all authenticated calls, and tracks the in-memory map of authenticated users.

nodes.name: Login & Credential Check
nodes.description: Authenticates a user against the SQL user table and mints a session token; the query is assembled by string concatenation, which is the SQL injection entry point.

nodes.name: Current User & Login IP
nodes.description: Resolves the caller identity from the bearer token for /rest/user/whoami and records the client IP of the last successful login.

nodes.name: Password Reset & Security Questions
nodes.description: Resets a password after checking the answer to a user-chosen security question, with no rate-limited lockout on the answer itself.

nodes.name: Change Password
nodes.description: Changes the password of the authenticated user from query parameters, without requiring the current password.

nodes.name: Two-Factor Authentication
nodes.description: TOTP enrolment, verification and disabling flow including the temporary token exchanged between the password and TOTP steps.

nodes.name: Authorization Guards & Roles
nodes.description: The isAuthorized/denyAll/isAccounting/appendUserId middleware factories that decide who may reach each route, plus their per-endpoint wiring.

nodes.name: CAPTCHA Challenges
nodes.description: Arithmetic and image CAPTCHAs guarding feedback submission and data export, with their answers stored server-side per request id.

nodes.name: Deluxe Membership & Premium Content
nodes.description: Upgrades a customer to the deluxe role, reports membership status and serves the paywalled premium reward asset.

nodes.name: Product Search
nodes.description: Full-text product search endpoint whose criteria are interpolated into a raw SQL query, making it both the union-SQLi and the reflected-XSS surface.

nodes.name: Product Catalogue Model
nodes.description: Sequelize model for products, including price, deluxe price and the HTML description rendered verbatim in the frontend.

nodes.name: Product Review Retrieval
nodes.description: Reads product reviews out of the NoSQL review collection for a given product id, without normalising the id parameter.

nodes.name: Product Review Writes & Likes
nodes.description: Creates, updates and likes reviews in the document store; the update path accepts a selector object straight from the request body.

nodes.name: Basket Retrieval
nodes.description: Loads a basket with its products for a basket id taken from the path, which is not checked against the session owner.

nodes.name: Basket Item Management
nodes.description: Adds, updates and quantity-checks basket items, enforcing deluxe-only quantity limits before delegating to the generated REST resource.

nodes.name: Coupon Redemption
nodes.description: Validates and applies a base85-encoded discount coupon to a basket, including the campaign coupon codes.

nodes.name: Checkout & Order Placement
nodes.description: Turns a basket into an order: computes totals and discounts, debits the wallet or card, renders the PDF confirmation and empties the basket.

nodes.name: Stock Quantity Management
nodes.description: Per-product stock records maintained by the accounting role and consulted during basket updates.

nodes.name: Order Tracking
nodes.description: Looks up an order by tracking id in the document store; the id flows into the query selector unescaped.

nodes.name: Order History & Delivery Status
nodes.description: Lists a customer's past orders, exposes the all-orders view to accounting and toggles per-order delivery status.

nodes.name: Delivery Methods
nodes.description: Delivery options with their price and deluxe price, seeded from static YAML and offered during checkout.

nodes.name: B2B Order Intake
nodes.description: Accepts XML/JSON B2B order payloads on /b2b/v2/orders and evaluates the order line inside a sandboxed expression.

nodes.name: Delivery Addresses
nodes.description: CRUD for customer delivery addresses used at checkout, with ownership derived from the appended user id.

nodes.name: Stored Payment Cards
nodes.description: Stores and lists saved credit cards per user and resolves a card by id during checkout.

nodes.name: Digital Wallet
nodes.description: Reads and tops up the in-app wallet balance that can settle an order instead of a card.

nodes.name: Web3 Wallet, Keys & NFT Minting
nodes.description: Listens for exploit contract addresses, verifies submitted deployment keys, and watches NFT mint events plus soulbound token ownership.

nodes.name: User Profile Page Rendering
nodes.description: Renders the server-side profile template with the user's username, which is interpolated into the template engine input.

nodes.name: User Profile Update
nodes.description: Persists username and profile changes posted from the profile page and re-issues the session cookie.

nodes.name: User Account Model
nodes.description: Sequelize user model with password hashing hooks, role, deluxe flag, TOTP secret and soft-deletion.

nodes.name: GDPR Data Export
nodes.description: Assembles a JSON export of the caller's orders, reviews, memories and profile after an image CAPTCHA check.

nodes.name: Data Erasure & Privacy Requests
nodes.description: Handles the account deletion / privacy request form, including the layout parameter that selects the rendered template.

nodes.name: Memories Photo Wall
nodes.description: Uploads and lists user photo memories with captions, backed by the disk upload storage.

nodes.name: Recycling Requests
nodes.description: Pomace recycling pickup requests with address and date, plus the accounting-only listing and blocking rules.

nodes.name: File Upload Pipeline
nodes.description: The chained upload middleware: presence check, size and type checks, then zip, XML and YAML processing of the uploaded buffer.

nodes.name: Profile Image Upload
nodes.description: Accepts a profile picture either as a multipart file or as a remote URL fetched server-side and written to the uploads folder.

nodes.name: Public & Quarantine File Servers
nodes.description: Serves files out of the simulated FTP directory and its quarantine subfolder based on a path parameter.

nodes.name: Encryption Key & Log File Servers
nodes.description: Directory listing and file download for the encryption key folder and the rotated access logs.

nodes.name: Promotion Video Handler
nodes.description: Streams the promotional video with byte-range support and injects the configurable subtitle track.

nodes.name: Customer Feedback & Complaints
nodes.description: Feedback entries with rating and comment plus complaint submissions with attachments, both exposed through the generated REST resources.

nodes.name: Support Chatbot
nodes.description: The JuicyBot conversational endpoint: trains the intent model, keeps per-user conversation state and evaluates bot responses.

nodes.name: Sequelize Instance & Model Registry
nodes.description: Creates the SQLite Sequelize instance, initialises every model and wires their associations; every SQL-backed route goes through here.

nodes.name: Database Seeding
nodes.description: Populates products, users, challenges, wallets, baskets and deliveries from the static YAML/JSON fixtures on every boot.

nodes.name: MarsDB Document Store
nodes.description: The embedded MongoDB-like store holding product reviews and order tracking documents, queried with raw selector objects.

nodes.name: Crypto & Sanitisation Helpers
nodes.description: Hashing, HMAC, coupon encoding, URL allow-listing and HTML sanitisation helpers shared by nearly every route.

nodes.name: Anti-Cheat Scoring
nodes.description: Measures time-to-solve and pre-solve interactions to estimate whether a challenge was solved authentically.

nodes.name: Challenge Verification Middleware
nodes.description: Middleware that inspects requests and responses to detect exploited vulnerabilities and mark the corresponding challenge solved.

nodes.name: Prometheus Metrics
nodes.description: Request, file-upload and challenge gauges exported on the unauthenticated /metrics endpoint and visualised in Grafana.

nodes.name: Application Logging
nodes.description: Winston logger plus the rotated combined access log stream written under logs/.

nodes.name: Challenge Model & Solve Logic
nodes.description: Core gamification: challenge records, dependencies, solve/notify helpers and CTF flag generation.

nodes.name: Coding Challenges (Find It / Fix It)
nodes.description: Extracts vulnerable snippets from source files, serves the fix options and grades submitted verdicts.

nodes.name: Progress & Continue Codes
nodes.description: Encodes solved-challenge progress into hashid continue codes and restores progress from them.

nodes.name: Easter Eggs & Hidden Pages
nodes.description: The layered easter-egg endpoints and the hidden privacy policy proof page, plus their startup customisation.

nodes.name: CTF Webhook Notifier
nodes.description: Posts solved-challenge events to an external webhook when running in CTF mode.

nodes.name: Angular App Shell & Routing
nodes.description: Root component, route table and admin guard that define the SPA navigation surface.

nodes.name: Frontend HTTP Service Layer
nodes.description: Angular services and the request interceptor that attach the bearer token and call the REST API.

nodes.name: Search Result View
nodes.description: Renders search hits and echoes the raw search term into the page title, which is where the reflected XSS lands.

nodes.name: Product Details & Review Editing
nodes.description: Product dialog rendering the HTML description and the review editing form.

nodes.name: Login & Registration UI
nodes.description: Login form with remember-me handling, OAuth entry point and the registration form including security question selection.

nodes.name: Administration UI
nodes.description: Admin-only user and feedback overview reached through the guarded /administration route.

nodes.name: Order Tracking UI
nodes.description: Displays the result of an order tracking lookup including the delivery status timeline.

nodes.name: Basket & Checkout UI
nodes.description: Basket view, delivery/payment selection and order summary screens of the purchase funnel.

nodes.name: Chatbot UI
nodes.description: The JuicyBot chat widget with its conversation storage and input handling.

nodes.name: Score Board UI
nodes.description: Challenge score board with filtering, sorting and progress cards driven by the challenge service.

nodes.name: Web3 & NFT UI
nodes.description: Wallet, sandbox and NFT unlock components that talk to the blockchain challenge endpoints.

nodes.name: Privacy & Security Settings UI
nodes.description: Data export, two-factor setup and last-login-IP screens grouped under the privacy & security section.

nodes.name: Configuration Loading & Validation
nodes.description: YAML configuration profiles, their typed schema and the startup validator that rejects inconsistent customisations.

nodes.name: Startup Preconditions & Dependency Checks
nodes.description: Verifies port availability, writable folders, Node version and installed dependency versions before the app boots.

nodes.name: Shared Utilities
nodes.description: Cross-cutting helpers for async route wrapping, config access, environment detection and string handling used everywhere.

nodes.name: Container & VM Packaging
nodes.description: Multi-stage Docker build producing the distroless runtime image, the compose file used for test runs and the Vagrant provisioning path.

nodes.name: Build & Task Tooling
nodes.description: npm scripts, Grunt packaging tasks and the TypeScript compiler configuration that produce the distributable.
